name: Cloxazolam
summary: Benzodiazepine derivate that is metabolised into delorazepam. Which is where most of its effects come from.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Cloxazolam is a oxazolobenzodiazepine derivative that has anxiolytic, sedative, and anticonvulsant properties.

uses.text: It is not widely used; as of August 2018 it was marketed in Belgium, Luxembourg, Portugal, Brazil, and Japan.
uses.brands: Akton, Cloxam, Clozal, Elum, Olcadil, and Sepazon

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dizziness, poor coordination and memory problems. Like other benzodiazepines it can lead to dependence, and stopping suddenly after regular use can cause severe withdrawal, including seizures. In overdose it can slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 常見作用包括嗜睡、頭暈、協調變差與記憶問題。和其他苯二氮平類一樣，它可能導致依賴，規律使用後突然停藥可能引發包括癲癇發作在內的嚴重戒斷反應。過量時可能抑制呼吸。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见作用包括嗜睡、头晕、协调制差与记忆问题。和其他苯二氮平类一样，它可能导致依赖，规律使用后突然停药可能引发包括癫痫发作在内的严重戒断反应。过量时可能抑制呼吸。

fact.en: Cloxazolam has an extra oxazole-type ring fused onto the benzodiazepine core. The body opens this ring to release delorazepam, which does most of the work.
fact.zh: Cloxazolam 在苯二氮平核心上多融合了一個噁唑類的環。身體會打開這個環，釋放出負責大部分藥效的地洛西泮。
fact.zhHans: Cloxazolam 在苯二氮平内核上多融合了一个恶唑类的环。身体会打开这个环，释放出负责大部分药效的地洛西泮。
